content:
Context: 9. Benefits to the families of Government servants who go missing during service

NPS employee would be made from the indemner as provided under OM, dated 25-6-2013. However, in the event of Government servant being declared dead at any time or after seven years, Government contribution and returns thereon from the accumulated pension corpus under NPS would be transferred to the Government account and remaining corpus comprising of employees' contribution and returns thereon would be paid to the nominee or legal heir, as the case may be in accordance with CCS (Implementation of NPS)
